daily.today_energy: The moon's whispering to your intuition rn—trust that gut feeling even if it doesn't make logical sense yet. Your energy is magnetic today, drawing the right people and opportunities closer.
daily.love: Whether you're coupled or solo, vulnerability is your superpower today. Let someone see the real you, messy parts included. Deep connections happen when we stop performing.
daily.career: Your creative ideas are hitting different today. Don't dim your vision to fit the room—the right people will vibe with your energy. Put yourself out there.
daily.health: Your body's asking for flow over force. Gentle movement, hydration, and rest hit harder than pushing yourself. Listen to what feels good instead of what feels productive.

weekly.overview: This week's energy invites you to trust your intuition over overthinking. Venus is softening your edges, making it easier to let people in. Expect unexpected conversations that feel weirdly timely. Your vibe is magnetic—lean into it.
weekly.love: Someone might be picking up on your energy harder than usual. Whether you're single or coupled up, there's potential for real vulnerability here. Don't hide your messy feelings; they're your superpower this week.
weekly.career: Your creative instincts are sharp right now. It's a good moment to pitch that idea you've been sitting on or approach a project differently. Your boss or team might surprise you with their openness to your perspective.
weekly.health: Your body's asking for gentleness this week. Honor rest when it calls. Moving your body in ways that feel good—not punishing—will shift your entire mood. Water element energy is strong; stay hydrated and grounded.
